sources_read.section: §1 gates 0-5, §2 how an agent thinks, §7 hard limits
§5.3 mode switch (manual authoritative, never silently exits), §5.6 export/traceability (the three-file zip, /NM = slug, the <!-- tb id=... --> anchor, append-not-re-render), RULE-14/15/25
§5.3 F6 (OPFS is not namespaced like Dexie — sign-out must wipe it), §4.1 DB-Q3, §5.3 F5/F8
the existing navigator.onLine handlers and the phaseChanged reconnect predicate (g1 rewires these)
phase is the mode switch; the slice already persists
deletes Dexie but not OPFS (g6 gap)
the per-profile OPFS cache (g6 wipe target)

scope: The manual mode switch and the reconnect banner, the offline UI convention (lastSyncedAt + disabled-with-reason), the export bundle (notes.md anchors, thinkboard.json, document.pdf annotation append) with fflate/pdf-lib, the re-import parser, and the sign-out/local-data wipe (Dexie + OPFS). Out of scope: rendering a group sheet (013, blocked on 012); ink/{slug}.svg for handwritten notes (only meaningful once 024/ink exists); the airplane-mode browser pass on a live stack.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reconnecting never syncs without the button: a manual Work-offline choice survives a navigator online event, and going offline only ever degrades the phase.
Every disabled control explains why: the offline banner shows lastSyncedAt and a DisabledWhenOffline wrapper renders a labelled disabled child, never a silently dead one.
N equals the outbox count and the banner's button is what moves the phase back to collaboration.
Original PDF bytes are appended to, never re-rendered: load the bytes, add /Highlight annotations with /NM = slug, save; the zip holds document.pdf, notes.md and thinkboard.json.

Export -> edit prose -> re-import creates no duplicates: the <!-- tb id=<slug> --> comment is the only identity anchor; an anchorless section becomes a new unanchored note; an unknown anchor is reported as an orphan, never guessed or dropped.
After sign-out OPFS holds no file of the previous profile, and the group (note-slot) document is not loaded/cached offline by default.

open_questions: D-10 (defaulted: the group document is not cached offline) — g6 encodes it as a cacheable-slot predicate (only `main`); if the product later wants the note copy offline, that predicate changes.
DB-Q3 (defaulted: per-profile Dexie; OPFS wiped with it) — g6 follows it.
RULE-15 (standing: on a conflict keep local text as a second note) — the re-import path only touches notes matched by the slug anchor; a conflict rule is not exercised by 016's own tests.

NEW-1: g2's 'group sheet read-only' references the sheets of task 013, which is blocked on 012. This task implements the offline UI parts that do not need a sheet (the banner, lastSyncedAt, the disabled-with-reason wrapper) and passes g2 on its acceptance criterion ('every disabled control explains why'); the sheet itself stays 013's. Raised, not silently substituted.
risks: A shared tablet leaking the previous user's PDF bytes (F6) — mitigated by wiping OPFS in the same sign-out that drops Dexie.
Re-rendering a page on export destroys the text layer (spec §5.6) — mitigated by loading and appending to the original bytes with pdf-lib, never re-rendering.
pdf-lib and fflate are new dependencies (the plan names fflate and a PDF writer is required by §5.6); both are lazy-imported on the export action, and npm audit is checked.

The reconnect change alters task 007's auto-resync behaviour on a browser online event (it now waits for the button, per spec §5.3); 007's own phase-change tests still hold because the cycle is still driven by a phase change.
